facts.claim: Two F-15EX Eagle II fighters assigned to the 67th Fighter Squadron arrived at Kadena Air Base, Okinawa, on November 15, 2026.
The U.S. Air Force photo release shows the second permanently assigned F-15EX touching down at Kadena.
The U.S. Air Force plans a total of 36 F-15EX aircraft at Kadena under a plan announced in 2024.
Kadena's F-15C/D phaseout began in November 2022, with rotating aircraft used during the transition.

zh.title: 美軍首批永久駐外F-15EX抵達沖繩嘉手納 基地規劃換裝36架
zh.summary: 兩架美國空軍F-15EX於11月15日抵達日本沖繩嘉手納基地，成為該機型首批永久部署海外的戰機，換裝計畫預定涵蓋36架。
body: 美國空軍兩架F-15EX「鷹II」（Eagle II）戰機於2026年11月15日飛抵日本沖繩嘉手納空軍基地，隸屬第67戰鬥機中隊。這是F-15EX首次以永久駐紮方式部署海外，美軍公布的現場照片顯示新機降落基地。此次抵達標誌嘉手納戰機更新計畫進入新階段，但不代表規劃中的所有飛機均已交付。
嘉手納原先長期部署F-15C/D戰機，美國空軍自2022年11月起逐步撤出老舊機隊。換裝過渡期間，基地以其他第四代及第五代戰機輪調方式維持兵力。美軍現在開始接收永久派駐的F-15EX，意在恢復由基地固定中隊操作的新型戰機編制，並持續維持區域防空與聯合作戰任務。
根據2024年公布的計畫，美軍準備在嘉手納部署總計36架F-15EX，由第44及第67戰鬥機中隊操作。這個數字屬於規劃部署規模，並非11月15日的交機數量。首批到位的只有兩架，後續將分階段增加；目前公開資訊尚未提供全部機隊到齊的確切日期。
F-15EX延續F-15雙發動機重型戰機的設計，導入更新的航電、電子戰設備及武器整合能力，可攜帶較多武器執行任務。美國空軍將其納入太平洋地區防空部署，並規劃與第五代戰機及日本航空自衛隊合作。相關能力是美軍公布的換裝目標，不應直接視為已經完成的實戰能力驗證。
嘉手納位於沖繩，是美軍在西太平洋的重要空軍基地。此次部署的新聞重點在於F-15EX首次永久進駐美國本土以外據點，與先前短期輪調的戰機有所不同。後續仍需觀察新機交付進度、兩個中隊的換裝時程，以及既有輪調部署將如何調整。

en.title: First permanently stationed US F-15EX fighters arrive at Kadena in Okinawa
en.summary: Two F-15EX Eagle II fighters arrived at Kadena Air Base on November 15, marking the type's first permanent overseas assignment; the US Air Force plans 36 aircraft there.
body: Two US Air Force F-15EX Eagle II fighters arrived at Kadena Air Base on Okinawa, Japan, on November 15, 2026. Assigned to the 67th Fighter Squadron, they are the first examples of the type to be permanently stationed outside the United States. The Air Force released photographs of the arrivals, including the second aircraft touching down at Kadena. The milestone marks the beginning of a new phase of the base's fighter modernization rather than completion of the whole fleet replacement.

Kadena previously hosted F-15C and F-15D Eagles for decades. A phased withdrawal of those older aircraft began in November 2022, and rotational deployments of other fourth- and fifth-generation fighters maintained a fighter presence while a permanent replacement was prepared. The newly arrived F-15EX aircraft will allow the base to begin transitioning its resident fighter squadrons to the updated Eagle variant.

Under a deployment plan announced in 2024, the US Air Force intends to station 36 F-15EX fighters at Kadena. Both the 44th and 67th Fighter Squadrons are expected to operate the aircraft. That figure describes the planned total, not the number delivered this week: the initial arrival comprised two aircraft. An exact timetable for bringing the remaining fighters to Kadena has not been announced in the latest public material.

The F-15EX builds on the twin-engine Eagle design while incorporating newer avionics, electronic-warfare equipment and expanded weapons carriage. The US Air Force says the aircraft will contribute to air defense and joint operations in the Pacific, alongside other US fighters and aircraft operated by Japan's Air Self-Defense Force. Those statements describe intended operational roles, and should not be read as confirmation that every element of the transition is already complete.

Kadena's location on Okinawa makes the permanent assignment a significant basing development in the western Pacific. Future updates will need to distinguish aircraft deliveries from operational integration and squadron conversion, as the replacement of the previous F-15C/D fleet proceeds in stages.

facts.claim: EASA issued AD 2026-0219 on November 16, 2026, effective November 30, for ATR42 and ATR72 de-icing pressure regulator and shut-off valve functional checks.
The new directive supersedes EASA AD 2025-0011 and covers specified ATR42 and ATR72 variants, including ATR72-212A.
The shortest interval for modified ATR42-400/500 and ATR72 aircraft is 160 flight hours, reduced from 1,050 hours.
Other configurations have intervals of 210 or 190 flight hours, with faults requiring correction before further flight.

zh.title: EASA發布ATR42與ATR72除冰系統新適航指令 最短每160飛行小時檢查
zh.summary: 歐盟航空安全總署11月16日發布適航指令2026-0219，要求ATR42與ATR72營運業者提高除冰系統閥門檢查頻率，11月30日生效。
body: 歐盟航空安全總署（EASA）於2026年11月16日發布編號2026-0219的適航指令，針對ATR42與ATR72系列渦輪螺旋槳飛機的除冰系統壓力調節及關閉閥，要求依機型與改裝狀態增加功能檢查頻率。指令預定11月30日生效，目的是降低閥門故障未被及時發現，並在結冰飛航環境下影響飛機操控的風險。
這項適航指令涵蓋多款ATR42與ATR72構型，包括ATR72-212A等子型號，並取代EASA於2025年1月發布的2025-0011號指令。EASA指出，問題涉及除冰系統氣源的壓力調節與關閉功能。部分故障可能在平常飛航時沒有明顯徵兆，直到飛機遭遇結冰條件、需要啟用相關系統時才顯現，因此要求縮短兩次檢查之間的間隔。
依航空專業媒體整理的新要求，已完成指定改裝的ATR42-400、ATR42-500及ATR72系列，部分構型的最長檢查間隔由原先1,050飛行小時大幅縮短至160飛行小時。未完成該項改裝的相關構型，則由700小時縮短至210小時；較早期的ATR42-200、-300與-320，檢查間隔由650小時縮短至190小時。實際要求仍須依各機型及適用條款判定。
當功能檢查發現閥門不符合要求時，營運業者必須先修正問題，才能讓飛機恢復飛行。如果現有原廠程序無法處理特定故障，也須取得經核准的修復指示後執行。這類適航指令屬主管機關對持續適航性提出的強制維修要求，並不等同所有受涵蓋飛機都已出現故障或發生飛安事件。
ATR72系列在全球區域航空市場廣泛使用，台灣華信航空也營運ATR72-600。對營運業者而言，新規定可能增加例行檢查與維修排程需求；個別飛機是否適用哪一組間隔，仍應以主管機關發布的正式指令、實際構型及符合性紀錄為準。配圖為ATR72-600資料照，並非除冰系統故障當事機。

en.title: EASA shortens ATR 42 and ATR 72 de-icing valve inspection intervals
en.summary: EASA issued AD 2026-0219 on November 16, requiring more frequent checks of de-icing system valves on ATR 42 and ATR 72 aircraft, effective November 30.
body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) issued Airworthiness Directive 2026-0219 on November 16, 2026, calling for more frequent functional checks of pressure regulator and shut-off valves in the de-icing systems of ATR 42 and ATR 72 turboprops. The directive takes effect on November 30. The agency is addressing the possibility that an undetected valve malfunction could reduce de-icing capability when an aircraft enters icing conditions, potentially creating a serious control hazard.

The measure applies to specified ATR 42 variants and ATR 72 configurations, including the ATR 72-212A. It supersedes EASA directive 2025-0011, issued in January 2025. The affected valves regulate pressure and control the supply of air used by the de-icing system. Because an abnormal condition may remain hidden until the equipment is needed, inspection frequency is an important part of the maintenance response.

For certain modified ATR 42-400, ATR 42-500 and ATR 72 aircraft, the maximum interval between functional checks falls from 1,050 flight hours to 160 flight hours. For applicable aircraft without the specified modification, the interval is reduced from 700 to 210 hours. Older ATR 42-200, -300 and -320 models face a reduction from 650 to 190 hours. The exact requirement depends on the aircraft variant and modification configuration, so operators must use the directive rather than a single fleet-wide interval.

If an inspection finds a defective valve, the problem must be corrected before further flight. Where existing maintenance procedures do not address the fault, the operator must obtain approved repair instructions and perform the required work. An airworthiness directive is a binding continuing-airworthiness requirement; its issuance does not mean every aircraft covered by it has experienced a system malfunction.

The ATR 72 family is used on regional routes around the world, including by Mandarin Airlines in Taiwan. The revised intervals may affect how operators plan recurring maintenance, while individual aircraft applicability must still be established through the official directive and configuration records. The accompanying ATR 72-600 photograph is a file image, not a photograph of a fault or incident.

facts.claim: United Airlines had a technology outage on November 16, 2026 that prevented pilots from receiving final aircraft weight data for takeoff performance.
United reported restoration at around 6 p.m. Eastern time; aircraft already airborne and United Express flights were unaffected.
United said it had no indication the disruption involved a cybersecurity incident and did not identify a cause.

zh.title: 聯合航空系統異常影響起飛重量資料 全美多地航班延誤
zh.summary: 聯合航空11月16日因電腦系統異常，機組員無法取得起飛性能計算所需的最終重量資料；航空公司表示美東時間晚間6時左右已恢復。
body: 美國聯合航空11月16日發生電腦系統異常，影響部分航班出發。根據航空公司及飛行員工會資訊，機組員一度無法取得計算起飛性能所需的最終飛機重量資料，必須等待系統恢復或確認必要資訊後才能離開登機門。當天各地出現延誤，但已在空中的航班及United Express營運航班未受這次異常影響。
飛機起飛前必須依實際重量、跑道及天氣條件核算起飛性能，相關資料無法確認時不宜逕行放行。工會通知指出，部分機組通訊應用程式也受到影響；航空公司表示，問題已於美東時間晚間6時左右排除，與最初通報相隔約1小時40分鐘。聯合航空稱目前沒有證據顯示涉及資安攻擊，故障根本原因尚未公布。
FlightAware當日晚間紀錄多架聯合航空航班延誤，但不能據此認定所有延誤及取消皆由單一系統故障造成。這次是航空公司內部系統異常，應與數日前美國聯邦航空總署的全國性航管通訊問題區分。

en.title: United Airlines flight departures disrupted by aircraft weight-data outage
en.summary: A November 16 technology outage prevented United pilots from receiving final aircraft weights for takeoff calculations; the airline reported a fix at about 6 p.m. Eastern.
body: United Airlines experienced a technology outage on November 16, 2026, delaying departing flights after pilots lost access to the final aircraft weight information needed for takeoff-performance calculations. A pilots' union communication said some crew applications were also unavailable. Flights already airborne and flights operated by United Express were not affected by this particular disruption.

Aircraft weight is one of the inputs crews need, together with runway and weather data, to determine safe takeoff performance. United said service was restored at about 6 p.m. Eastern time, roughly one hour and forty minutes after the first pilot reports. The airline said it had no indication of a cybersecurity incident but had not publicly identified the underlying technical cause.

Flight tracking data showed numerous United delays that evening, although the total cannot be attributed solely to this outage. The airline's internal systems problem was separate from an earlier nationwide air traffic control communications disruption involving the Federal Aviation Administration.

facts.claim: Azul Conecta's first Cessna SkyCourier PS-ENE entered service on November 3, 2026 under a four-year Petrobras crew transport contract.
The aircraft has 19 passenger seats and is scheduled to fly Carauari-Coari-Manaus on Fridays and the reverse on Mondays, with seats available to ordinary passengers.
Azul Conecta expects another SkyCourier in the first half of 2027 but has not set a date for possible Barcelos service.

zh.title: 藍色航空子公司首架SkyCourier投入亞馬遜航線 兼載油田員工與一般旅客
zh.summary: 巴西Azul Conecta首架19座SkyCourier於11月3日投入營運，執行亞馬遜地區油田員工運輸，部分固定航段亦對一般旅客售票。
body: 巴西藍色航空旗下區域航空公司Azul Conecta已於2026年11月3日投入首架賽斯納Cessna SkyCourier雙發渦輪螺旋槳飛機，註冊編號PS-ENE。新機以運送巴西國家石油公司Petrobras的亞馬遜地區油田員工為主要任務，合約期為4年，同時規劃在部分往返航段銷售一般旅客機位。
依目前公布的航班安排，這架19座飛機每週五由Carauari經Coari飛往瑪瑙斯，週一反向飛行；不具油田員工身分的旅客也可購票。相較Azul Conecta原有9座Cessna Grand Caravan，SkyCourier能運送更多旅客，但仍適合需求不足以使用ATR72的偏遠區域航線。
航空公司預期2027年上半年再接收一架SkyCourier，並評估其他航點；相關新增航線尚未公布確定開航日期。所附照片為2021年SkyCourier原型機資料照，並非這次投入服務的PS-ENE。

en.title: Azul Conecta puts first Cessna SkyCourier into Amazon service for oil workers
en.summary: Azul Conecta's first 19-seat SkyCourier entered service on November 3 under a Petrobras transport contract, with some return-sector seats also sold to the public.
body: Brazilian regional carrier Azul Conecta placed its first Cessna SkyCourier, registration PS-ENE, into service on November 3, 2026. The twin-engine turboprop is being used primarily to transport Petrobras employees to and from oil operations in the Amazon region under a four-year contract. The airline is also offering seats to ordinary passengers on certain scheduled sectors.

Under the announced schedule, the 19-seat aircraft travels from Carauari through Coari to Manaus on Fridays, returning in the opposite direction on Mondays. It offers more than twice the seating capacity of Azul Conecta's nine-seat Cessna Grand Caravan while serving routes where traffic does not justify a larger ATR 72.

Azul Conecta expects a second SkyCourier in the first half of 2027 and is considering additional destinations, but no launch date has been confirmed for those potential routes. The accompanying image shows a SkyCourier prototype in 2021, not Azul Conecta aircraft PS-ENE.
